title: Australia Proposes Off Switch for Social Media Algorithms
excerpt: Australia introduces a proposal requiring social media platforms to give users the option to turn off recommended content.
body_html:
Australia has introduced a new legislative proposal aimed at social media companies. Under the plan, platforms would be required to provide users with a mechanism to switch off recommended content.

The measure targets algorithmic feeds that continuously suggest material to individuals. If implemented, the proposed off switch would give users more control over what appears on their screens by bypassing automated content recommendations entirely.
